newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks pull back at close, eye Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks pull back at close, eye Wall Street.

text.p: MADRID, June 30 (Reuter) 1505 GMT - Madrid stocks ended lower on Monday with a slide in early New York trade pushing the bourse into profit-taking, dealers said.

Endesa was the notable exception, although dealers said they were unaware of what specifically was pushing the stock higher. Some speculated that the only explanation for such a sharp rise could be position-taking ahead of the upcoming privatisation. * General index down 3.96 points, 0.66 percent, to 600.62 * Ibex down 54.86 points, 0.79 percent, to 6,884.56 * Endesa adds 200 pesetas to 12,370 * Repsol ends down 30 pesetas, off an early high of 6,390 pesetas after the Industry Ministry said it was removing the LPG price freeze, seen boosting year-end results, analysts said.
Stocks saw profit-taking after the recent run-up to levels where many shares are beyond fair-value.
Banks in particular corrected sharply, but dealers see the sector outperforming again later in the year.

Gas Natural overturned initial sharp gains after the government approved an around one percent fall in the domestic tariff and an up to three percent fall in the industrial tariff. The shares eventually closed down 240 pesetas to 32,190.

Stocks are seen testing new highs again soon, helped by the recent maturing of a special 760 billion peseta government debt issue, with much of those funds seen coming into the share market in search of higher returns.
